title: Ebara Corporation Annual Securities Report (有価証券報告書), 159th term (FY ended December 31, 2023), Japanese original
notes: 有価証券報告書 for the 159th term, 1 January 2023 to 31 December 2023, filed 2024-03-28. THE SEGMENT-REORGANISATION FILING: states explicitly (physical p.39) that from Q1 of this fiscal year reportable segments changed from three (Fluid Machinery/Environmental Plant/Precision & Electronics) to five (Buildings & Industry/Energy/Infrastructure/Environment/Precision & Electronics), and that the prior year's (FY2022) comparative figures are reclassified onto the new segmentation for comparison. The restated FY2022 Precision & Electronics comparative column here (orders 301,551 / revenue 222,259 / profit 36,183) is identical to the as-originally-reported figures in ebara_fy2022_yuho_jp's own current-year column -- confirming the reorganisation split only the old Fluid Machinery segment and left Precision & Electronics itself unchanged.
